slice.leaf: Audit currently installable or connected Chat-capable generic HTTP/webhook transports for the exact OpenTimestamps /digest need without installing, connecting, or sending a live digest.
slice.action: Capability discovery only. Searched the current ChatGPT plugin directory for webhook, HTTP, REST API, generic API, Zapier, Make, Pipedream, Postman, and HTTP Request concepts; inspected currently exposed connected tool surfaces. No plugin was installed or connected and no outbound OpenTimestamps request was sent.
observations: Plugin-directory search for webhook returned Apollo.io only, which is not a generic arbitrary HTTP/webhook transport.
Plugin-directory search for webhook OR HTTP OR generic API OR REST API returned Apollo.io only; no generic request transport was discoverable.

Plugin-directory search for Zapier OR Make OR Pipedream OR Postman OR HTTP Request returned Airtable, Binance, freddy, TickTick, and vidIQ; none exposes a source-qualified arbitrary binary HTTPS POST contract in the discovery result.

The currently connected/exposed GitHub surface is endpoint-scoped to GitHub operations, while native web access is retrieval/search oriented; neither exposes an arbitrary unauthenticated binary POST body plus raw binary response primitive to an arbitrary allowlisted calendar URL.

required_transport_contract.request: HTTPS POST to an allowlisted OpenTimestamps calendar /digest endpoint with an exact 32-byte binary body and no authentication
required_transport_contract.response: Return HTTP status plus raw binary response bytes so the serialized Timestamp can be persisted before any retry
required_transport_contract.retry: No same-run retry; preserve at-least-once semantics because repeated digest submissions are not proof-byte/server-append idempotent

candidate_comparison.reason: GitHub-endpoint scoped; not an arbitrary URL binary POST transport
no arbitrary request-body POST/raw-binary-response primitive exposed

candidate_comparison.candidate: installable plugin directory result set from bounded generic-transport queries
candidate_comparison.reason: no generic HTTP/webhook transport appeared in the bounded discovery results; absence from these queries is not proof that no such plugin can exist globally or later

slice.tested_scope: Only the currently exposed Chat tool surfaces and bounded current plugin-directory discovery queries listed above. No claim is made that ChatGPT can never expose such a transport, that no future/plugin-specific transport exists, or that OpenTimestamps itself is unsuitable.

frontier: The OpenTimestamps protocol-level candidate remains attractive because its documented public-calendar path is unauthenticated and free, but immediate creation is still transport-blocked in the currently observed Chat surface.
No qualifying generic HTTP/webhook transport contract was discoverable in bounded current plugin-directory searches or connected tool surfaces.

This is a current-surface negative result, not a global impossibility claim. The exact missing capability is arbitrary allowlisted HTTPS binary POST with raw binary response bytes and durable response persistence before retry.
